open_points.subject: Modeling boundary
open_points.text: “an artifact pointer for a link the agent or the owner makes” conflicts with M05’s “the import (M10) for a pointer the import brought in”
open_points.question: Is every ArtifactPointer a link made by the agent or owner, or may import create a pointer representing a legacy link made by neither?
options: Imported pointers are an explicit third origin
The owner is treated as making every imported link
Only agent- or owner-made links may become pointers
open_points.default_guess: Treat import as an explicit third origin representing a pre-existing legacy link.

open_points.subject: Model M05 — ArtifactPointer
open_points.text: “a reference to a document a service holds about a project” conflicts with R0-60’s “a pointer whose document was deleted or moved stays as it is”
open_points.question: Does the pointer assert that the owner service currently holds the document, or only record the link as it was made regardless of the document’s later existence or location?
options: It records only the historical link claim
It asserts possession only when first published
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as a historical link claim that does not assert current existence or location.

open_points.subject: Model M05 — ArtifactPointer digest provenance
open_points.text: “its content digest when its publisher gave one” and “The digest is its publisher’s claim” are ambiguous for an imported pointer whose publisher is defined as “the import itself — the migration closure (M10), not a principal”
open_points.question: Whose claim is the digest on an imported pointer: the legacy publisher’s claim transported by import, the owner/import action’s claim, or an un-attributed imported value?
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as an un-attributed imported value preserved from the source, not a claim made by the MigrationClosure.
